nodes.text:
1. About HMPV Virus
Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) was first discovered in 2001 by Dutch researchers.This virus originated from Birds and infects poultry. Researchers believe it likely emerged from zoonotic transmission (from animals to humans) long ago. https://t.co/7QdEugr9TB

nodes.author: AdityaD38926787
nodes.text:
2. WHERE IS IT SPREADING ?
Recent reports indicate a significant surge in HMPV cases in China🇨🇳, leading to overwhelmed hospitals & increased public concern
Malaysia has a notable increase in HMPV cases, with 327 reported in 2024
India, 2 cases of HMPV have been reported https://t.co/tfY43OKfGy

nodes.author: AdityaD38926787
nodes.text:
3. HOW DOES IT SPREAD ?
HMPV is transmitted through respiratory droplets such as Person to Person contact, Contact to contaminated surface, Contact to droplets of coughing of an infected Person, similar to many other respiratory viruses. https://t.co/ATwrpyOoKT
